- [RARC.5.2.5] **Logical-fact truth maintenance.** A `logical` fact is
  retracted when its last justifying activation ends ([LLOG.15]). The engine
  coalesces justifiers: a fact asserted by two activations lives while at least
  one of them remains ([LLOG.2]). Its assertion and its retraction reach the
  stream as any fact's do, as `fact_assert` and `fact_retract` events
  (`proto/stream_event_kind.proto`).
